summary: Iteration 6 — Bulk Upload, ItemEditor edit-mode with notes + avoid preference, Never-Worn Nudge, Outfit Feedback, About You (gender/age/photo), and 'Visualise on me' (Nano Banana) all validated end-to-end. BACKEND 20/20 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter6_features.py, 86.6s). Covers: (a) PATCH /api/items/{id} notes persists, preference=avoid persists, invalid preference→400, preference=neutral clears; (b) POST /api/stylist/generate prefer_unworn=true→200, avoided item NEVER included across 2 runs, focus_item_id on an avoided item IS allowed (id present in result); (c) POST /api/stylist/feedback verdict up/down→200, meh→400, empty item_ids→400; GET /api/stylist/taste returns liked/disliked counts + avoided_items array populated; (d) PUT /api/profile gender/age persisted, age=2→400; POST /api/profile/photo with generated 600x900 JPEG→200 {photo_path}, GET /api/profile shows photo_path, GET /api/files/{path}→200 image/*; POST /api/stylist/visualize before photo→400; after photo with 3 item_ids→200 {storage_path, cached:false} in ~25s, GET file→image/*, reversed ids→cached:true (same sorted key); DELETE /api/profile/photo removes photo_path AND invalidates cached visualizations; (e) two sequential POST /api/items/upload calls both return 200 and both items list in GET /api/items (bulk uses this endpoint). FRONTEND 390x844 mobile web (3 fresh signups): (1) Bulk upload — hidden <input type=file> file chooser reports is_multiple()==True; set_input_files with 2 JPEGs shows bulk-review with bulk-progress-label '1 OF 2 · ANALYSING…' then '2 OF 2 READY' (~12s total); both bulk-row-0/bulk-row-1 rendered; edited bulk-0-name-field to 'Bulk Test Shirt' and tapped bulk-0-cat-Tops; save-batch-btn labelled 'Save 2 to Closet' → Closet shows 7 items total ('7 ITEMS') with 'Bulk Test Shirt' visible in Tops. (2) Item detail — tap item → edit-item-btn → item-edit-form → edit-name-field 'Edited Name' + edit-notes-field 'Runs small' → save-edit-btn → name updated + item-notes rendered with 'Runs small'; toggle-avoid-btn shows avoid-badge 'NOT SUGGESTED', second tap removes it. (3) Profile ABOUT YOU — about-you renders 'I AM' chips + 'AGE' input + 'YOUR PHOTO · FOR VISUALISE ON ME'; gender-Female tap succeeds; age-input '28' + blur commits (server returned 200); profile-photo-empty visible initially; photo-library-btn opens file chooser, set 600x900 JPEG → profile-photo image renders (~4s); photo-remove-btn → profile-photo-empty visible again + toast 'Photo removed'. (4) Never-Worn Nudge — Stylist empty state shows unworn-nudge '5 PIECES NEVER WORN' (fresh account with 5 seed items, insights.never_worn_count=5); tapping produces user bubble + outfit-result in 15s (Gemini 3.1 Pro). (5) Feedback UP — feedback-up-btn tap flips label to 'YOU LIKED THIS'. (6) Visualize without photo — visualize-btn on the result card labelled 'VISUALISE ON ME · ADD YOUR PHOTO IN PROFILE'; tap surfaces toast with toast-action 'GO'; tapping GO navigates to Profile tab (about-you visible), so the user is one tap away from adding their photo. (7) Piece sheet exists — outfit-result has 5 piece-{id} elements ready for tap-to-open piece-sheet. No React Native red-screen errors, zero console errors. No deprecated Expo packages used in new code (expo-image-picker, expo-image). No layout regressions on 390x844 (tabs and FAB visible above JS tab bar; usesNativeTabs=false).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stylist_generate correctly whitelists focus_item_id against avoided pieces (L603 keeps an avoided item only if it is the focus), matches the spec 'focus on avoided item still allowed' — verified.
server.py POST /profile/photo (L864) invalidates cached visualizations on every new photo upload — good, otherwise a new face would be shown in a cached image.
visualize cache key = sorted(item_ids) (L905) → reversed order hits cache; confirmed empirically.

add-item.tsx (L94-101) sets allowsMultipleSelection:true + selectionLimit:10 + orderedSelection:true; on web this is the native <input multiple> attribute (file_chooser.is_multiple() == True verified).
about-you.tsx commitAge (L34-42) validates locally 5-120 before hitting API; matches server bound at server.py L845.
item/[id].tsx togglePreference (L69-77) optimistically calls applyUpdate then invalidates; UI badge switches instantly — no lag observed.

Non-blocking suggestion: stylist.tsx visualize toast → Profile navigation loses the current stylist context; consider a return-CTA from Profile back to Stylist once the photo is saved so users can visualise the look they were on without re-generating.
seed_data_creation: 3 fresh signup accounts (iter6ui_*, iter6b_*, iter6c_*@example.com / pass1234), each auto-seeded with 5 mock items. iter6ui also has 2 bulk-uploaded items (Bulk Test Shirt + a green photo). One backend account (iter6_<hex>@example.com) exercised full profile-photo lifecycle including a real Nano Banana visualise call. No cleanup — isolated test users, safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env → https://stylevault-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest single-file (avoid the default -n auto in pytest.ini): pytest tests/test_iter6_features.py -o addopts='' -v. Real Nano Banana visualise call takes ~25s + costs a Gemini credit each time; the test caches so second call is instant. Frontend mobile viewport 390x844. Key new testIDs: bulk-review, bulk-progress-label, bulk-row-{i}, bulk-{i}-name-field, bulk-{i}-cat-{Category}, bulk-{i}-color-field, bulk-retry-{i}, bulk-remove-{i}, save-batch-btn; edit-item-btn, item-edit-form, edit-name-field, edit-notes-field, cancel-edit-btn, save-edit-btn, item-notes, toggle-avoid-btn, avoid-switch, avoid-badge; unworn-nudge; feedback-up-btn, feedback-down-btn, piece-{itemId}, piece-sheet, piece-swap-btn, piece-remove-btn, piece-ban-btn; about-you, gender-{Female|Male|Non-binary|Prefer not to say}, age-input, photo-camera-btn, photo-library-btn, photo-remove-btn, profile-photo, profile-photo-empty, photo-uploading, photo-error; visualize-btn, viz-image; toast-action. On web, expo-image-picker's file input is hidden — always use `async with page.expect_file_chooser() as fc_info: await page.get_by_test_id('choose-photo-btn').click(force=True); fc = await fc_info.value; await fc.set_files([...])` to attach files (list for bulk). Fresh signup seed has 5 items, all unworn → never_worn_count=5 → nudge visible. Gemini 3.1 Pro stylist latency 12-30s; Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana) 15-30s.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All spec'd behaviour matches implementation: bulk multi-select works because launchImageLibraryAsync sets allowsMultipleSelection which maps to <input multiple> on web; avoided pieces are correctly filtered from stylist prompts unless focus_item_id explicitly points at them; the empty-photo visualize-btn correctly renders the 'ADD YOUR PHOTO IN PROFILE' state and its Go toast navigates to Profile via router. Cached visualisation keys use sorted item_ids so ordering is irrelevant, and uploading a new profile photo invalidates the cache so the try-on image always reflects the current person.
